## Monday

Shadow a working session and write down the words the team actually uses.

## Wednesday

Ship a small change with a partner. Write the decision in [Decisions](item:decisions) if it will matter next month.

## Friday

Add one page that would have helped you on Monday. Link it from [Getting started](item:getting-started) if everyone needs it.
